news_items.headline: Chevron declares $1.78 quarterly dividend, ex-date May 19, 2026
news_items.summary: CVX declared a $1.78 quarterly cash dividend with ex-date May 19, 2026, reinforcing shareholder return commitment alongside ongoing buybacks.

news_items.headline: CVX shares tick up; upside capped by resistance at $198 (weekly report)
news_items.summary: Chevron closed the week at $191.96, +$1.37 (+0.73%) over seven trading days. Weekly indicators on Buy/Strong Buy signals; main scenario is consolidation near current highs with potential breakout above $198.

news_items.headline: Berkshire Hathaway trims Chevron stake; analysts still see strong growth
news_items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway reduced its CVX position in latest 13F. Analysts maintain Buy/Strong Buy consensus, citing rising oil prices and recent asset divestments.

news_items.headline: Chevron expands Venezuela heavy-oil footprint via asset swaps; RBC raises PT
news_items.summary: Chevron expanded its Venezuelan presence through recent asset swaps, enhancing its heavy-oil footprint. RBC Capital raised its price target on the strategic moves and rising crude prices.

news_items.headline: Wells Fargo maintains Buy rating on Chevron
news_items.summary: Wells Fargo reiterated a Buy rating on CVX, citing the company's ability to generate strong free cash flow under current crude price environment.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: RBC Capital set PT to $220 on 2026-05-05 (~21.73% upside). Wells Fargo maintained Buy. Latest consensus (May 18, 2026): 23 analysts — 18 Buy, 6 Hold, 1 Sell; high PT $236, low $170.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 (reported 2026-05-01): EPS $1.41 vs $0.96 expected (+46.87% beat) despite lowest quarterly profit in five years; record oil output. Next earnings projected EPS $4.56. Near-term tailwind: Middle East conflict-driven crude price surge estimated to add ~$1.7B in Q1 earnings; $2.5B in Q1 2026 buybacks plus continued dividend.
